    //==
    // # Frame and basis operations
    //
    // Matrix interchange between the coordinate frames of `transforms.types.plato`
    // and the rigid poses they are equivalent to, plus the basis of a rotation.

    //==
    // Frames and bases — orthonormal frames are rigid poses in matrix-friendly
    // clothing: the axes are the rotation, the origin is the translation.

    // The affine matrix mapping frame-local coordinates to world coordinates
    // (axes become the linear rows, the origin the translation row).
    Matrix3x2(f: Frame2D): Matrix3x2
        => (Number2(f.XAxis.Vector.X, f.XAxis.Vector.Y),
            Number2(f.YAxis.Vector.X, f.YAxis.Vector.Y),
            Number2(f.Origin.X, f.Origin.Y));

    // The frame of a rigid pose: the pose's rotated unit axes at its position.
    Frame2D(pose: Pose2D): Frame2D {
        var x = Vector2D(1.0, 0.0).Transform(pose.Rotation);
        var y = Vector2D(0.0, 1.0).Transform(pose.Rotation);
        return (pose.Position, Direction2D(x), Direction2D(y));
    }

    // The rigid pose of a frame. Precondition: the axes are orthonormal and
    // right-handed.
    Pose2D(f: Frame2D): Pose2D
        => f.Matrix3x2.Pose2D;

    // Any frame is affine: its frame-local-to-world matrix is the affine map.
    AffineTransform2D(f: Frame2D): AffineTransform2D
        => AffineTransform2D(f.Matrix3x2);

    // The homogeneous matrix mapping frame-local coordinates to world
    // coordinates.
    Matrix4x4(f: Frame3D): Matrix4x4 {
        var x = f.XAxis.Vector;
        var y = f.YAxis.Vector;
        var z = f.ZAxis.Vector;
        var o = f.Origin;
        return (Number4(x.X, x.Y, x.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(y.X, y.Y, y.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(z.X, z.Y, z.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(o.X, o.Y, o.Z, 1.0));
    }

    // The frame of a rigid pose: the pose's rotated unit axes at its position.
    Frame3D(pose: Pose3D): Frame3D {
        var q = pose.Orientation;
        var x = Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0).Transform(q);
        var y = Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0).Transform(q);
        var z = Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0).Transform(q);
        return (pose.Position, Direction3D(x), Direction3D(y), Direction3D(z));
    }

    // The rigid pose of a frame. Precondition: the axes are orthonormal and
    // right-handed.
    Pose3D(f: Frame3D): Pose3D
        => f.Matrix4x4.Pose3D;

    // Any frame is affine: its frame-local-to-world matrix is the affine map.
    AffineTransform3D(f: Frame3D): AffineTransform3D
        => f.Matrix4x4.AffineTransform3D;

    // The world-axis images under a rotation: the columns of its rotation
    // matrix as a (generally orthonormal) basis.
    Basis3D(q: Quaternion): Basis3D
        => (Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0).Transform(q),
            Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0).Transform(q),
            Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0).Transform(q));

    // The linear map that sends the world axes to the basis vectors; the
    // translation row is zero, since a basis carries no origin.
    AffineTransform3D(b: Basis3D): AffineTransform3D
        => AffineTransform3D(Matrix4x3(
            Number3(b.X.X, b.X.Y, b.X.Z),
            Number3(b.Y.X, b.Y.Y, b.Y.Z),
            Number3(b.Z.X, b.Z.Y, b.Z.Z),
            Number3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)));

    //==
    // # Transform identity statics
    //
    // The do-nothing transform of every representation in the transform family,
    // gathered in one place so the identity of a rotation, a pose, a TRS transform,
    // a matrix, an affine map, or a projective map is found by the same lookup.

    //==
    // Identity statics — the do-nothing transform of each representation,
    // reachable as `Type.Identity` via the `_: Type` static convention.

    // The zero rotation.
    Identity(_: Rotation2D): Rotation2D
        => Rotation2D(0.0.Angle);

    // The identity rotor (scalar 1, no bivector part).
    Identity(_: Rotor2D): Rotor2D
        => (1.0, 0.0);

    // The identity quaternion (0, 0, 0, 1).
    Identity(_: Quaternion): Quaternion
        => (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);

    // The identity rotor (scalar 1, no bivector part).
    Identity(_: Rotor3D): Rotor3D
        => (1.0, Bivector3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0));

    // The identity motor (identity rotation, zero translation).
    Identity(_: Motor3D): Motor3D
        => (Quaternion.Identity, Quaternion(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));

    // The pose at the origin with no rotation.
    Identity(_: Pose2D): Pose2D
        => (Point2D.Origin, Rotation2D.Identity);

    // The pose at the origin with no rotation.
    Identity(_: Pose3D): Pose3D
        => (Point3D.Origin, Quaternion.Identity);

    // The TRS transform that leaves everything unchanged.
    Identity(_: TrsTransform2D): TrsTransform2D
        => (Vector2D.Zero, Rotation2D.Identity, Number2.One);

    // The TRS transform that leaves everything unchanged.
    Identity(_: TrsTransform3D): TrsTransform3D
        => (Vector3D.Zero, Quaternion.Identity, Number3.One);

    // The identity 2D affine map.
    Identity(_: Matrix3x2): Matrix3x2
        => (Number2(1.0, 0.0), Number2(0.0, 1.0), Number2(0.0, 0.0));

    // The identity 3x3 matrix.
    Identity(_: Matrix3x3): Matrix3x3
        => (Number3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), Number3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), Number3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));

    // The identity 3D affine map.
    Identity(_: Matrix4x3): Matrix4x3
        => (Number3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), Number3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), Number3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), Number3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0));

    // The identity 4x4 matrix.
    Identity(_: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4
        => (Number4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), Number4(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0), Number4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0), Number4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));

    // The identity 2D affine transform.
    Identity(_: AffineTransform2D): AffineTransform2D
        => AffineTransform2D(Matrix3x2.Identity);

    // The identity 3D affine transform.
    Identity(_: AffineTransform3D): AffineTransform3D
        => AffineTransform3D(Matrix4x3.Identity);

    // The identity 2D projective transform.
    Identity(_: Transform2D): Transform2D
        => Transform2D(Matrix3x3.Identity);

    // The identity 3D projective transform.
    Identity(_: Transform3D): Transform3D
        => Transform3D(Matrix4x4.Identity);
